plan: Since this mechanism functions like a second-price auction (the sealed bid acts as an exit point in the ascending clock, and the winner pays the second-highest bid), the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value. Bidding my value ensures I win whenever it's profitable (value > second-highest bid) and avoid losses when it's not. Bidding higher risks overpaying; bidding lower risks losing profitable auctions. With value $20, I'll bid $20.

Since this is effectively a second-price auction (the ascending clock mechanism means I pay the second-highest bid if I win, determined by my sealed bid acting as my exit point), the dominant strategy is to bid my true value. Bidding exactly my value ensures I win whenever my value exceeds others' bids and pay only the second-highest bid, maximizing expected profit without risk of overpaying or losing profitable trades.
